prompt: Out of all of the feature-length theatrical films that John Carpenter directed before 2015, which has the longest running time?
answer: **Starman (1984)**, directed by John Carpenter, has the longest running time among his feature-length theatrical films released before 2015: **115 minutes (1 hour 55 minutes)**.
